output.summary: The evidence does not support deprioritisation of Arts. Matched non-SlotBook tickets resolve within 0.3 days of other faculties. SlotBook tickets, routed to the P4 best-effort queue, account for about 70% of the median gap. The remaining gap is largely Lindqvist on-site coverage, and Education shows the same pattern. The P4 acknowledgement gives no priority or timeframe, so requesters were not told. Whether Arts leadership was informed of RR-17 is unestablished. The SlotBook ticket spike has confounds: SSO go-live, term start and a new category. Best next steps are a written SlotBook support agreement with a corrected acknowledgement, and a split monthly report. Blanket P4 for Arts is harmful. Decommissioning SlotBook and transferring the desk budget are premature.
